notes.title: Update 2.4 released!
notes.notes:
[img]http://www.steampowered.com/v/gfx/apps/230780/extras/Articy_Release_SteamWhite.png[/img]

Update 2.4 is the biggest free feature update for articy:draft 2 so far. It does not only contain the much-anticipated [b]simulation mode[/b], it also brings a whole bunch of major [b]location editor improvements[/b].

On top of that we also implemented feature requests from the community like the possibility to clone single-user projects and support for floating multi-user licenses. Besides many other bug fixes version 2.4 also improves the performance for editing text – providing you with a much smoother writing experience.

Watch the [url=http://www.nevigo.com/redirect/?release2.4whatsnew] video[/url] or read about it on our [url=http://www.nevigo.com/en/articydraft/whatsnew/] Website[/url].

notes.title: articy:draft 2 SE | Version 2.2 released
notes.notes:
This announcement informs you about the most important changes and improvements introduced by version articy:draft 2 SE version 2.2. ([url=http://store.steampowered.com/app/230791/][b]articy:draft SE - Upgrade to articy:draft 2 SE DLC required[/b][/url])

You can also find a detailed change list [url=http://www.nevigo.com/help/index.php?product=articydraft&lang=en&page=RecentChanges]here[/url].

[h1][b]New![/b] "Conditional flow logic"[/h1]

The most significant set of improvements concern modeling logic in the Flow using variables, conditions and instructions.

[b]Global Variables[/b]
In a new area in the project structure called “Global Variables” you can create variable sets (i.e. “Quest Variables”) and fill them with variables, sometimes called “flags”. Variables can be Boolean (true / false) or Integer numbers.

You can use those variables in condition scripts or assignments.

[b]New flow nodes: Conditions / Instructions[/b]
To use conditional branching points or pieces of script code in the Flow, you can add these two new node types. The text fields for conditions and instructions support syntax highlighting and auto-completion.

[i]Make sure to switch this on in the Flow-settings for migrated projects.[/i]

[b]Conditions and instructions as property types in templates[/b]
A new “script” property type allows you to use text fields for scripting (with syntax highlighting and auto-completion) in your templates.

[b]Circular node connections[/b]
You can now connect a node’s output pins with its input pins to create loops.

notes.title: Free update of articy:draft SE adds in-app tutorial!
notes.notes:
Today Nevigo GmbH releases a free update to articy:draft SE that adds a complete in-app tutorial to get you up to speed in your favorite story & game design tool, articy:draft SE. 

The update also includes minor bugfixes and improves the performance of articy:draft SE.

For more information on articy:draft, please visit [url=www.nevigo.com]www.nevigo.com[/url]

We hope you enjoy the update!

Your team at Nevigo.
